questionResults.question: Which teams are in the AFC?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT teams.name
FROM teams
JOIN conferences ON teams.conference_id = conferences.conference_id
WHERE conferences.name = 'AFC';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The AFC teams are the Bills, Dolphins, Patriots, Jets, Ravens, Bengals, Browns, Steelers, Texans, Colts, Jaguars, Titans, Broncos, Chiefs, Raiders, and Chargers.

questionResults.question: Who is the head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs?
questionResults.sql: SELECT coaches.name FROM coaches JOIN teams ON coaches.team_id = teams.team_id WHERE teams.city = 'Kansas City' AND teams.name = 'Chiefs';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The head coach of the Kansas City Chiefs is Andy Reid!

questionResults.question: Who is the team captain of the Buffalo Bills?
questionResults.sql: SELECT captains.name FROM captains JOIN teams ON captains.team_id = teams.team_id WHERE teams.city = 'Buffalo' AND teams.name = 'Bills';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Josh Allen is the team captain of the Buffalo Bills!

questionResults.question: Which teams play in week 1?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.name
FROM teams t
JOIN games g ON t.team_id = g.home_team_id OR t.team_id = g.away_team_id
WHERE g.week = 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: All 32 teams play in week 1: Patriots, Seahawks, Rams, 49ers, Bears, Panthers, Bengals, Buccaneers, Lions, Saints, Bills, Texans, Ravens, Colts, Browns, Jaguars, Steelers, Falcons, Jets, Titans, Chargers, Cardinals, Dolphins, Raiders, Packers, Vikings, Eagles, Commanders, Cowboys, Giants, Broncos, and Chiefs.

questionResults.question: Which AFC teams play at home in week 2?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT teams.name
FROM teams
JOIN conferences ON teams.conference_id = conferences.conference_id
JOIN games ON teams.team_id = games.home_team_id
WHERE conferences.name = 'AFC' AND games.week = 2;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The AFC teams playing at home in week 2 are the Bills, Ravens, Texans, Patriots, Jets, Titans, Broncos, Chargers, and Chiefs.

questionResults.question: Who coaches the team that Patrick Mahomes captains?
questionResults.sql: SELECT coaches.name FROM coaches JOIN captains ON coaches.team_id = captains.team_id WHERE captains.name = 'Patrick Mahomes';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Andy Reid coaches Patrick Mahomes’s team.
